title: The Woven Bag That Looks Expensive
subtitle: the it bag · summer 2026
story: Premium woven raffia, structured silhouette, contrast tan leather handles with a subtle gold buckle. The kind of bag that quietly elevates everything — a white linen tank, a flowing maxi dress, wide-leg trousers. Looks like designer, but it's from Amazon under $85.

products.name: JW PEI Hana Mini Woven Tote
products.description: Cream raffia weave, contrast tan leather handles, gold buckle detail, structured silhouette

styling_tips.label: On Size
styling_tips.text: The mini fits a phone, small wallet, sunglasses, and a silk scarf — the perfect everyday-to-evening size. If you carry more, JW PEI also makes the Hana in a regular size with the same elegant shape.

styling_tips.label: Styling
styling_tips.text: The cream-and-tan palette is a neutral foundation that elevates everything. Pair with white linen for the Mediterranean look, with cream wide-leg pants for office-quiet, with a slip dress for evening. The gold buckle is the hero — let it shine against soft fabrics.

styling_tips.label: Care
styling_tips.text: Spot clean with a slightly damp cloth — never soak the raffia. Store stuffed with tissue paper to keep the structured shape. Avoid leaving in direct sun for hours — the leather handles will darken slightly over time, which actually adds character.

meta_description: JW PEI Hana woven tote that looks expensive but is from Amazon under $85. Cream raffia with tan leather handles — the it bag of summer 2026, perfect for quiet luxury outfits.
